decisions.reason: Passenger data transmission sits close to the core aviation offer and has its own page, so its results likely meet aspirations and regulatory demand (API/PNR) keeps it relevant.

Demand for travel health requirements is fading after the pandemic, which puts it at risk of falling short of aspirations, but it has its own page and low running costs, so slack lets the firm keep it for now.
A cyber awareness training module fits the firm's certified-trainer resources and growing compliance demand, so there is no clear shortfall that would trigger search for other uses.

Behaviour analysis builds on the firm's specialist detection expertise and supports diversification, though it is only mentioned on the website and its results remain uncertain; slack in a large firm allows it to be carried.
Passenger profiling is core aviation security know-how that is low-cost to maintain, so the firm keeps it despite limited visibility on the website.
A document verification platform close to the established offer with its own page likely performs near aspiration and serves ongoing airline needs.
